backgroundTasks.autoResumeHint: Off by default — when on, background sub-agent runs interrupted by a crash/quit are re-dispatched at startup (attempt-capped).
backgroundTasks.denyListHint: One glob per line over subagent ids (e.g. Explore, myplugin:*, template:*). Denied ids never enter the dispatch_agent tool and are refused at dispatch time.
backgroundTasks.description: Background sub-agent lifecycle and dispatch permissions.
backgroundTasks.maxAttemptsHint: Cap on chained auto-resume attempts per run lineage (prevents crash loops).
backgroundTasks.surfaceAsksHint: On (default): a dispatched sub-agent's permission prompts appear in this chat. Off: they are auto-denied.
backgroundTasks.title: Background tasks & permissions

description: Reusable templates and live status for sub-agents spawned by a parent agent. Templates persist across sessions; runtime data is ephemeral.
discardBody: This panel has unsaved changes. Leaving now discards them.

import.description: Read sub-agent configurations from external tools and convert them to cognia templates or characters.

errors.pickFailed: Could not read the selected files.

import.noDrafts: No agents were parsed from the selected files.
import.tauriPickFolderHint: Select a directory containing agent files.
import.tauriPickHint: Pick one or more agent files from your filesystem.
import.title: Import sub-agents
import.webPickHint: Drop files here or click to browse.

nav.emptyFiltered: No sub-agents match the current filter.
nav.title: Sub-agents

nesting.description: Let the chat agent dispatch sub-agents that can themselves dispatch further sub-agents, with controlled depth, budget, and cycle/timeout guards.
nesting.dispatchMaxRetriesHint: Retries for transient dispatch failures (rate-limit, timeout, network, sidecar restart). 0 disables. Default 1.
nesting.enabledHint: Off by default — the agent keeps the standard single-level Task tool.
nesting.maxDepthHint: How many levels below the chat a sub-agent may nest (1–5).
nesting.timeoutHint: Wall-clock limit per dispatch subtree. 0 = no limit.
nesting.title: Nested sub-agents
nesting.tokenBudgetHint: Stop dispatching deeper once a subtree burns this many tokens. 0 = unlimited.

pluginSection.missingBody: The plugin that declared this sub-agent is no longer registered.
pluginSection.readOnlyBody: The plugin manifest is the source of truth for this sub-agent. Change it in the plugin, not here.

callout.body: Sub-agents spawned by an Agent Team or chat session appear here while running. The list is in-memory and clears on app restart. Start a teammate task in Agent Teams to see this fill.
callout.title: Live registry, populated during runs

runtime.cancelUnreachable: That run is not executing in this window — it may have already finished, or it was started by the SDK's own Task tool, which registers no abort handle.
runtime.description: Currently-executing sub-agents and their last activity. Updates live as the orchestrator emits events.
runtime.emptyBody: Sub-agents spawned by an active chat will appear here. The runtime is in-memory and resets when the app restarts.
runtime.title: Running now
runtime.toolsRunCount: {n, plural, one {# tool run} other {# tools run}}

templates.description: Built-in and user-created sub-agent templates. Built-ins are read-only — duplicate to fork an editable copy.
templates.dispatchOnlyBody: Pinning a provider or an external runtime takes this sub-agent off the parent's runtime, so it is not offered in ordinary chat. It stays reachable through nested dispatch.
templates.editorAllowNestingHint: Let this sub-agent dispatch its own sub-agents (up to the depth cap).
templates.editorExternalRuntimeHint: Run this subagent on an external CLI agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) instead of the built-in engine. Desktop only; the external agent uses its own model and auth.
templates.editorProviderModelHint: Run this subagent on a specific provider + model (cross-provider). Leave unset to inherit the session's.
templates.enabledHint: Off excludes this sub-agent from dispatch, discovery, and every picker.
templates.forkOnlyBody: Built-in templates are starting points, not runnable sub-agents — the resolvers skip them. Duplicate one to get an editable, dispatchable copy.
templates.hiddenHint: Stays dispatchable, but is left out of pickers and @-mention autocomplete.
templates.mcpHint: MCP servers forwarded into this sub-agent's session. Inherit passes through whatever the parent has.
templates.missingBody: It may have been deleted in another window.
templates.promptShadowedBody: A system prompt outranks the task template, so the task template below — and the variables declared for it — will not be used. Clear the system prompt in Advanced configuration to bring them back.
templates.promptShadowedTitle: The task template is not being used
templates.railBlockedBody: This sub-agent needs the nested-dispatch rail, which is currently off. Turn on nested dispatch (or run the session in plan mode) to make it reachable.
templates.title: Templates
templates.toolsHint: Inherit gives this sub-agent the parent's tools. A custom list grants exactly those. Disable all leaves it with none.

title: Sub-agents

toolCatalog.description: Pick the tools this sub-agent may call. Ids are the namespaced form the model sees.
toolCatalog.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# tool selected} other {# tools selected}}
toolCatalog.title: Choose tools
toolCatalog.unknownHint: Granted earlier; its provider is not available right now. Kept unless you clear it.

modeHints.inherit: Whatever tools the dispatching agent has.
modeHints.none: No tools at all — the sub-agent can only reason and reply.
